name: build-android-app-plugin
description: Build and ship Android apps from your AI assistant: 22 skills, 21 plain-English slash commands, 6 subagents, 5 MCP servers, 6 hooks, per-project resumable build loop. Built for non-technical vibe coders, end-to-end: intake → scaffold → debug → publish to Play Store internal test track.

interface.shortDescription: Build, run, debug, and ship Android apps — from idea to Play Store in one plugin
interface.longDescription: Use Build Android App to turn a one-line idea into a working Android app and submit it to the Play Store. The plugin handles intake, scaffolding, signing, listing, and uploading. 22 skills cover the full lifecycle (intake → ship → update). 21 slash commands use plain English. 6 subagents run in parallel. 5 MCP servers drive adb, Gradle, the Play Developer API, keystore operations, and asset generation. Per-project state.json makes every loop resumable.
defaultPrompt: Build or ship an Android app: type /make-app for a new app, /import to take ownership of an existing one, or /publish to ship to the Play Store.
